# Preface {.unnumbered .unlisted}

A short preface introducing the book. Explain the motivation, the intended
audience, the prerequisites, and how the book is organized.

## How to read this book {.unnumbered .unlisted}

Conventions used in the book: code in monospace, package names in bold,
references in citation form. Replace this section with whatever conventions
your book follows.

## About this template {.unnumbered .unlisted}

The two chapters of Part One document the template rather than a subject:
structure, cross-references, equations and theorems in the first, figures,
tables and the back-of-book index in the second. Read them once, then
delete them --- they are demo content, and nothing else depends on them.

Render the book with `quarto render` from the project root, which builds
every format in `_quarto.yml`, or `quarto render --to pdf` for print only.
Output lands in `_book/`, with the PDF named after the book title. In
RStudio the Build tab's Render Book button does the same thing; its
dropdown selects a single format.
